name: Orion EFT-1
about: Orion EFT-1 (2014-077A), a crewed vehicle (Artemis), launched 2014 Dec  5. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2014 Dec  5), held fixed
